note: These four arms are the complete action set for pi(x_t). Texts are FIXED and must not be altered after this point. A0 carries no message at all (not an empty message) so that CONTINUE is a true no-op on the dialogue prefix.

A0.name: CONTINUE
A0.description: No extra message is appended; the agent simply takes its next step from the saved prefix.

A1.name: WARNING
A1.text: Re-check the goal, the latest observation, and your previous action. Continue only after correcting any inconsistency you notice.

A2.name: REPLAN
A2.text: Construct a fresh, concise plan from the current goal and observable state. Then execute that plan.

A3.name: ROLLBACK_REPLAN
A3.text: The previous attempted action has been reverted. Construct a fresh, concise plan from the current goal and restored observable state. Then execute that plan.
A3.environment_operation: Restore environment AND dialogue state to just before the most recent reversible action (BaseAdapter.rollback_checkpoint), then append the text above.

injection_protocol.position: The overseer text is appended to the observable transcript as an [OVERSEER] entry immediately BEFORE the agent's next action decision at the checkpoint step.
injection_protocol.persistence: The overseer entry remains in the transcript for the remainder of the episode, matching how a real runtime overseer message would behave.
